title: IT60121: Mathematical Foundations For Signal And Image Processing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Vector spaces and linear algebra: Linear independence, basis, norms, inner
product spaces, Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, orthogonality, projections, Leastsquare filtering, MMSE estimation, Wiener filtering, Linear operators and
matrix inverses, Matrix factorizations- LU, QR, Eigenvalues and eigenvectors,
diagonalization of matrices, KL Transform, PCA, SVD, Toeplitz, Circulant
matrices and their properties Case study: Face recognition by eigenfaces
Estimation theory: Maximum-likelihood principle, Cramer-Rao bound, Maximum aposteriori (MAP) estimation, Kalman filter, extensions such as EKF, UKF,
Particle filter Case study: Tracking objects/people in videos.Optimization
theory: Gradient-descent, conjugate-gradient, Simulated annealing, graph cuts,
loopy belief propagation, EM algorithm, Theory of constrained optimization,
Lagrange multipliers, Dynamic programming, Viterbi algorithm, Hidden Markov
models, Gaussian mixture modelsCase study: Image de-noising, inpainting, stereo
disparity computation, speech/speaker recognition
